source: NOAA NCEI IBTrACS v04r01, North Atlantic basin, via crc-sdk IBTrACSPlan
citation: Schreck et al. (2024), IBTrACS v04r01, NOAA NCEI, doi:10.25921/82ty-9e16
rule: storms with at least one best-track point inside the Texas box; tracks clipped to the clip box
extent_note: r34/r50/r64 are US agency estimates of the largest radius of 34, 50 and 64 kt winds in the NE, SE, SW and NW quadrants (nautical miles); rmw is the radius of maximum wind, roci the radius of the outermost closed isobar; null where IBTrACS has none
wind_note: WMO agency wind where present, else US agency wind (wind_source says which); knots, 10-minute or 1-minute mean per agency; category is NOAA USA_SSHS
